name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael's journey into motorsport IT began unconventionally. A self-taught coder since childhood, he initially pursued a career in finance technology. However, the roar of engines always resonated louder. He volunteered at local karting events, offering his IT skills to improve race timing and data analysis. This passion led him to a role optimizing telemetry systems for a stock car team, and eventually to Formula racing. Rafael believes in robust, reliable systems above all else. He emphasizes clear documentation and proactive maintenance, viewing IT infrastructure as the backbone of a successful racing operation.

Rafael's pragmatic approach is born from years of troubleshooting under pressure. He's seen firsthand how a single IT glitch can derail a race. He focuses on building modular, easily-replaceable systems to minimize downtime. He's known for his calm demeanor in crisis and his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues. His colleagues appreciate his methodical nature and the way he empowers them with knowledge, ensuring everyone understands the systems they use.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rafael has a focused look with a strong jawline and a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Insists on using a mechanical keyboard for all coding, claiming it improves focus.
Carries a small notebook filled with system diagrams and handwritten notes.
Always has a cup of strong Brazilian coffee on his desk, meticulously brewed.
